title: LAS CHIAPANECAS PASOS BASICOS | FOLKLORE MEXICANO

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down folk dance steps step-by-step, combining verbal explanation with demonstrations. He emphasizes upper body posture, skirt handling, and footwork counts.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the lesson on Chiapanecas dance steps.
Breaks down the first basic step without skirt.
Teaches the second basic step (golpes and plantas).
Puts on the traditional skirt to demonstrate skirt work.
Combines step one with skirt movements.
Teaches directional changes and turns with the skirt.

common_mistakes: Lifting the skirt too high or going too diagonal
Not maintaining skirt line in the center

steps_taught.name: Basico / Terciado
steps_taught.description: Three-count stepping pattern similar to a terciado.

steps_taught.name: Golpes y plantas
steps_taught.description: Striking the foot and alternating plant steps forward.

what_works: Clear verbal counts and direct visual angles on feet.
what_hinders: Quick transitions between barefoot practice and skirt demonstration.

quotes.text: Iniciamos super rápido con este primer paso.
El terciado como su nombre lo dice va a consistir en tres tiempos.
Vamos a hacer golpes a la derecha e izquierda.
Vamos a dejar ocho tiempos para la entrada de la canción.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front showing foot position in black boots.
Teacher demonstrates stepping pattern counting 1-2-3 in place.

extraction.distinctive_method: Separates learning footwork first without props, then introduces skirt handling separately before combining them.
